steps.content: Start at the central garden fountain.
How many major towers surround the park?
Start at Ayala Terrace Gardens, near the central lawn.
Scan the QR code near the central sculpture.
Look around. How many large stone planters are arranged around the lawn?
Head towards the nearest entrance into the mall from the gardens.
How many levels can you see listed on the mall directory at this entrance?
Go inside and find the escalators closest to this entrance.
What is directly beside the escalators?

hints.text: Look at the shopfronts from the bottom of the escalators.

steps.content: Take the escalator up one level.
Scan the QR code placed near the top of the escalator.
Walk towards the balcony area overlooking the gardens.
From above, how many distinct pathways cut through the garden below?
Head back down and exit towards the main road (Ayala Center Cebu entrance).
Outside, what type of vehicles are most commonly waiting?
Final step: Return to the gardens and locate the hidden cache near the sculpture.
